exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (colloquial) the sound of talking, the sound of voices, the sound of speech
to articulate, to pronounce, to utter
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: го́вор — (colloquial) the sound of talking, the sound of voices, the sound of speech; вы́говорить — to articulate, to pronounce, to utter; пригово́р — sentence, verdict; перегово́ры — talks, negotiation.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: reproof; reprimand; rebuke, scolding; dressing down, admonition
to talk, to have a talk, to speak (to, with)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: догово́р — agreement, contract, pact, treaty; вы́говор — reproof; reprimand; rebuke, scolding; dressing down, admonition; говоря́щий — talking, speaking; переговори́ть — to talk, to have a talk, to speak (to, with).
**договорить** — договори́ть (perfective): to finish speaking/saying/telling. Wiktionary: до- + говори́ть.
